name: Jamie Emerson
title: Principal Engineer | Digital Platforms & Technical Strategy
intro: I lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of software for ambiguous, data-heavy problems where the first challenge is deciding what the system should be. Across 15+ years, I’ve led airline telemetry and operations analytics, designed research software supporting peer-reviewed neuroscience, replatformed an aerospace web ecosystem, and co-founded and grew an agency to acquisition. I translate business objectives into architecture, platforms, and execution, and stay hands-on through delivery.

experience.name: BETA Technologies
experience.description: Aerospace manufacturer developing electric aircraft, propulsion systems, and charging infrastructure.
bullets: Defined and led execution of a web strategy to reposition BETA's site from a brochure into an educational platform for an emerging industry, with organic and AI-assisted discovery as explicit design goals.

Own platform architecture and roadmap across the application, data layer, cloud infrastructure, deployment pipeline, analytics, and integrations, establishing the development lifecycle, environments, and operating model for a production-grade platform.
Position the website as an integration point across the company's broader technology stack, expanding its role beyond marketing to support sales, operations, and leadership.
Established the measurement strategy and site-wide event instrumentation that give marketing and leadership visibility into user behavior, engagement, and conversion.

experience.name: Bilte Co
experience.description: Technical consultancy and product studio providing platform architecture, product development, systems integration, and fractional technical leadership to startups, research groups, and enterprise teams.
bullets: Lead technical strategy, architecture, and hands-on delivery for digital platforms, data systems, internal tools, and enterprise integrations for organizations including Southwest Airlines, Yale University, and NetApp.

Advise client stakeholders on platform architecture and modernization, translating ambiguous commercial or research goals into scoped delivery plans, technical roadmaps, and production software under constrained timelines and budgets.
Assemble, mentor, and lead senior multidisciplinary teams, owning architecture and delivery quality from discovery through launch.
Own product architecture and hands-on engineering for socky.flights, extending Bilte's work beyond client consulting into independent product development.

experience.name: Emerson Stone
experience.description: Emerson Stone was a strategy-led digital product and brand agency serving Fortune 500 and growth-stage clients including IBM, 3M, Section.io, and Audi. Acquired in 2019.
bullets: Co-founded and grew the agency from zero, hiring and leading engineers, designers, and operations staff while maintaining high delivery standards and a durable team culture.
Owned technical strategy from pre-sales through delivery: discovery, estimation, architecture, integrations, migrations, audits, and handoff.
Built trusted executive and technical relationships that supported deeper engagements and sustained strong year-over-year revenue growth throughout the agency's six years.
Served as senior technical lead across frontend, backend, CMS, ecommerce, and enterprise marketing work, pairing hands-on implementation with team mentorship.

products.name: socky.flights
products.description: Architected and built an aviation intelligence platform that transforms real-time airport, fleet, and aircraft data into performance and utilization benchmarks, supporting competitive research, surfacing operational trends, and informing more efficient resource planning.
